A1-12.3.title: Einladung an Julia und Anfrage an Sprachakademie München
A1-12.3.situation:
Teil 1: Assess a short informal email of approximately 30 words to Julia (a friend): (1) invite her to a weekend party, (2) specify day, clock time and location, (3) ask her to bring food or drinks. Check a suitable greeting and closing, use of du/dir/dich, clarity, task coverage and basic grammar. Do not require an exact wording or a weil clause.

Teil 2: Assess a short formal email of approximately 30 words to Sprachakademie München. Cover three points: (1) intention to register for a summer German course, (2) ask for course times and costs, (3) state when the learner would like to begin. Check a formal greeting and sign-off, use of Sie/Ihnen, correct task coverage and clear A1 grammar. Do not require payment details or a specific month; accept any suitable summer start preference.
points: Teil 1: invite her to a weekend party
Teil 1: specify day, clock time and location
Teil 1: ask her to bring food or drinks
Teil 2: intention to register for a summer German course
Teil 2: ask for course times and costs
Teil 2: state when the learner would like to begin
